says: In today's tooling, the 0113 lint hold passes a shell or Python file whose name has any extension but .sh or .py (run.bash, run.zsh, run.SH, run.pyw, or run.txt with a #!/bin/sh line), and an extensionless one whose launcher it does not name (#!/usr/bin/env -S uv run --script, #!/bin/busybox sh) or that has no #! line.
proof: A scratch node script calling check([...NOT_YET_PORTED, ...paths], text) from oxlint-plugins/tracked-scripts.ts at 8e0929db gave no finding for tools/run.bash, tools/run.zsh, tools/run.SH, tools/run.pyw, tools/run.txt, tools/run.v2, tools/uvtool, tools/busy and tools/noshebang, and new_script for tools/envdash, tools/envS and tools/py2. SCRIPT (line 43) matches only \.(?:sh|py)$ and BARE (line 46) only names with no dot.
cost: A new shell or Python script can enter the repo past the check 0113 says holds it, by naming it .bash or running Python through uv.
